title: Pipeline parallel silently trains with fewer layers than configured
root_cause: Integer division (num_layers // pp_size) silently drops layers when not evenly divisible. No assertion existed outside the virtual pipeline block.
invariant: actual total transformer layers across all PP ranks == configured num_layers
fixed_behavior: assertion error at startup — rejects the invalid configuration
notes: Fixed version crashes (correct behavior). This commit's --mock-data has a compatibility issue requiring a monkey-patch for get_blend_and_blend_per_split.

expected_output.buggy: BUG DETECTED: model has 4 layers, missing 1 layer(s)
expected_output.fixed: AssertionError: Number of layers should be divisible
